# Oneway OS

> Oneway OS runs a business, a community or a place from one operating system: Systems for every industry, a Brain, and its website.

Oneway OS is the business platform of Oneway; the social network and the Oneway App are https://oneway.center/.

## Pages

- [Oneway OS](https://onewayos.com/): Oneway OS runs a business, a community or a place from one operating system: Systems for every industry, a Brain, and its website.
- [Business OS for Entertainment & Venues](https://onewayos.com/os-business-entertainment): Events people say Going to in the Oneway App, check-in at the door, spaces to book, and the upkeep behind every night, on Oneway OS.
- [Business OS for Hospitality](https://onewayos.com/os-business-hospitality): Hotel operations on Oneway OS: rates, group blocks, deposits, the front desk and night audit, guest traces, rewards, and one intake for a property's systems.
- [Business OS for Additional Industries](https://onewayos.com/os-business-industries): Rental property on Oneway OS: the rent roll, leases, statements and what is past due. And a Center for museums, schools, clubs, churches and cities.
- [Business OS for Restaurants](https://onewayos.com/os-business-restaurants): Run a restaurant's floor from one Center: tables and sections, every seating, a waitlist guests join from the App, bookings, turn times and the 86 board.
- [Oneway Business OS](https://onewayos.com/os-business): Business OS is the full business operating system for a Center: Systems from the System Store, the Brain and Cross Projection. $330 a month for one Center.
- [Oneway Asset Management](https://onewayos.com/systems/asset-management): Asset management and maintenance in Oneway OS: a register of every thing, lending, warranties, condition, downtime, work orders and preventive upkeep.
- [Oneway CRM](https://onewayos.com/systems/crm): Oneway CRM: every customer's whole story from real bookings, visits and messages, with a pipeline, follow-ups, lists, consent and import, in Oneway OS.
- [Oneway Hotel Operations](https://onewayos.com/systems/hotel-operations): Hotel Operations in Oneway OS: rates and the book, the front desk, the night audit, folios and house accounts, housekeeping and traces, on one Center.
- [Oneway HVAC Service Operations](https://onewayos.com/systems/hvac): HVAC software in Oneway OS: calls to job tickets, dispatch with arrival windows, the tech's day on a phone, equipment history and service agreements.
- [Oneway Inventory Management](https://onewayos.com/systems/inventory): Oneway Inventory tracks stock, orders, sales and deliveries across your supply chain: the right goods in the right place at the right time.
